source: Simulated Daily Reports CSV - Daily Reports.csv
normalized_hash_definition: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify(DailyCore.reports(input)); excludes dataset metadata and source annotations.

reference.sha256_definition: Original Windows workspace bytes. Git transport uses UTF-8 without BOM and LF line endings; use canonical_utf8_lf_sha256 across platforms.
reference.alignment: All 12 supplied issue IDs remain represented in the existing reference. Report narratives are unchanged; only three due-date formatting strings differ after normalization. Reference definitions were not changed to fit predictions.

previous_input.notes: Earlier evaluations retain their original input hashes and predictions. They must not be pooled as runs on the current source bytes.

notes: Authoritative main demonstration input is the CSV supplied by the team on October 22, 2026.
Only the 18 daily-report source fields enter reports-a and sample downloads; the three supplied annotation columns are retained separately.
Blank weather cells are preserved as empty strings; they are not replaced by Not recorded.
Crew counts and due-date strings follow the supplied CSV exactly after the standard string/whitespace normalization.
The records are synthetic; independent team adjudication and real-project validation remain pending.
